owner: KFB ToolBox / shared social-story authoring seam
purpose: Small shared record contract for Resident↔Resident and Resident↔Player gift/social proofs without replacing ChatterBox, navigation, animation, inventory/save, combat or world owners.

references.persistenceConcept: Fractal Almanac / Journey Memory / Session save layer

invariants: Perception creates candidates; it does not start movement, dialogue, combat or transfer.
A running Activity declares whether it is interruptible and how it may resume.
Only one selected motive is active for one initiator at a time in v0.
A SocialPair reservation must exist before an NPC begins a targeted social approach.
Navigation/path execution remains host-owned; social logic requests an approach but never teleports.
ChatterBox may provide text/register/tell/reaction hints but never writes movement, bones, inventory truth, damage or persistent rewards.
Gift ownership changes exactly once at TRANSFER_COMMIT.
GiftInventoryItem stores source refs and state only; it never duplicates asset binaries.
MemoryReceipt is written only after a meaningful completed or committed event and stores no full transcript.
Visual backpack mesh/profile is presentation and is not inventory truth.
Bond/familiarity, temporary Kayfabe Heat and topic stance remain independent concepts.
Abort paths release SocialPair and restore or replace the prior Activity without half-mutated gift state.

fields.candidateId: stable event/candidate id for this evaluation
fields.kind: RESIDENT | PLAYER | GIFT_TARGET | CARD_POI | PROP_POI | ACTIVITY_STATION | DIRECT_SOCIAL_REQUEST | HOST_EVENT
fields.reasonTags: small string array, e.g. pending-gift, callback, card-relevance
fields.observedAt: simulation tick or host time ref

fields.kind: RESPOND | GIFT | CALLBACK | SHOW | BANTER | SHARED_ACTIVITY | CHALLENGE | INSPECT_POI | CONTINUE
fields.priorityBand: small explicit ordinal/category, not opaque utility score

fields.kind: GIFT | GIFT_GAG | BANTER | SHOW | CALLBACK | PLAYER_GIFT_CONVERSATION | KAYFABE_CHALLENGE
fields.state: OPEN | RUNNING | WAITING_PLAYER | RESOLVED | ABORTED | RELEASED
fields.reactionRequests: semantic reaction ids, never clip/bone instructions
fields.transferState: NONE | OFFERED | ACCEPTED | COMMITTED | DECLINED | DEFERRED

fields.eventType: gift-transfer | gift-gag | social-callback | kayfabe-scrap | help-up | player-call | shared-activity
fields.callbackTags: small reusable tags, not transcript text

commitPoints.transferCommit: EncounterBit.transferState = COMMITTED and GiftInventoryItem/provenance state update occurs atomically from the receiving save owner
commitPoints.release: SocialPair transitions to RELEASED and activity resumes/reselects

abortRules: Before TRANSFER_COMMIT, giver retains gift state.
After TRANSFER_COMMIT, abort cannot silently return the gift; any reversal is a new explicit event.
Path failure, target-busy, timeout or player walk-away releases SocialPair.
An aborted encounter does not create durable MemoryReceipt unless the abort itself is intentionally meaningful.
Late ChatterBox/LLM output does not reopen a released encounter.
